item.title: Unpacking The Ableism Of Employment Market And Its Implications For Inclusion And Access
item.description: Inclusion is not simply a matter of policy, intent or installing some infrastructure to enable access for certain physical disabilities. The post Unpacking The Ableism Of Employment Market And Its Implications For Inclusion And Access appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: ‘Single Salma’ Review: Charting Self-Love As A Feminist Revolution
item.description: 'Single Salma' breaks the norm of treating singlehood as a burden and reframes it as an agential choice many women choose in today’s modern world, considering they do not wish to live a life like their mothers, who were forced to lead a life against their wishes. The post ‘Single Salma’ Review: Charting Self-Love As A Feminist Revolution appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: The Women Potters Of Salampur: Gender, Labour And Craft In Bengal
item.description: Understanding the nuances of the work that women potters from Salampur do, sheds light on the gendered nature of craft work. The post The Women Potters Of Salampur: Gender, Labour And Craft In Bengal appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: The Arithmetic Of Fear: Indian Muslim Women And The Demographic Imagination
item.description: The myth of the ‘hyper-fertile’ Indian Muslim woman survives, not because it is empirically true, but because it is politically useful. The post The Arithmetic Of Fear: Indian Muslim Women And The Demographic Imagination appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: ‘Perfect Family’ (2025): When Therapy Enters The Indian Living Room
item.description: 'Perfect Family' asks the question: are we ready to reflect not just on the Karkarias, but on our own unspoken inheritances of trauma? The post ‘Perfect Family’ (2025): When Therapy Enters The Indian Living Room appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Dating Under Watch: How Family Support Shapes Queer Women’s Intimate Lives
item.description: The dating life of most queer women is influenced by family surveillance in India. The post Dating Under Watch: How Family Support Shapes Queer Women’s Intimate Lives appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Rule For Some, Exception For Others: Grant Of Bail To Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh
item.description: This article discusses the Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh case to outline how paisa, patriarchy and politics wield power over truth, justice and righteousness in India. The post Rule For Some, Exception For Others: Grant Of Bail To Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Beyond The Record: Feminist Archives And The Politics Of Memory
item.description: Feminist archives are less about being neutral or permanent and more about staying grounded in local knowledge, responding to what matters now. The post Beyond The Record: Feminist Archives And The Politics Of Memory appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: The Indigenous Women Weavers’ Invisible Labour Behind Mamdani’s Eri Silk Tie
item.description: Indigenous women weavers face precarious wages and exploitative intermediaries who profit from the vocabulary of “conscious fashion.” The post The Indigenous Women Weavers’ Invisible Labour Behind Mamdani’s Eri Silk Tie appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Rama Duwaji And The Politics Of Feminist Art In Spaces of Power
item.description: Rama Duwaji’s politics lie in the everyday: bodies leaning into one another, women holding space, acts of care rendered as quietly radical. The post Rama Duwaji And The Politics Of Feminist Art In Spaces of Power appeared first on Feminism in India.
